text.tspan: The next person who checks the same UPI ID, number or website is warned (S4)

svg.text: pastes the "VIP stock tips" message, language Hindi
validate input, rate limit (30 checks an hour per user)
regex: UPI IDs, phones, links, wallets
extract claims (each quote must appear word for word)
domain age (2 s limit, never fetches the user's link)
link context: salted HMAC identifiers vs earlier high-risk or reported checks
score with fixed signals S1-S7 (code only), band: high risk / caution / no known signals
guards: right script, no made-up IDs, no invented reports, never "safe", else fixed text
save check (masked evidence, hashed identifiers), cache it
verdict, score, signals with evidence, next steps, share URL
"High risk" + the exact lines that gave it away
draw the card in Hindi, open the share sheet
tap Report (optionally consent to keep the text)
report linked to the check's identifiers
